[b][i]Tribus Games Indie Pack[/i][/b]


Have fun with our latest games from Tribus Games.


This collection contains the games:



[b][i]Jigsaw Puzzle - Animals[/i][/b]

If you like puzzles and animals this is the right game for you, Jigsaw Puzzle - Animals is a minimalist game with 5 difficulty levels (60, 112, 273, 476 and 714 pieces) with an animal theme.





20 different puzzles.

Automatically saved parts so you never lose your progress.

5 levels of difficulty (60, 112, 273, 476 and 714 pieces).

10 background colors to change.

Zoom and move the scene, highlight border pieces, mix the remaining pieces, preview the scene.

Relaxing music and atmosphere.

Minimalist.
 


[b][i]Pure Soul: The Journey of the Witch Emily[/i][/b]


Pure Soul: The Journey of the Witch Emily tells the story of a young girl who is looking for answers about her mother, she ends up embarking on a journey in a fantasy world full of adventures and dangers, now Emily has one more mission, save the people who are turning into monsters.
In Pure Soul: The Journey of the Witch you control the Witch Emily who has just discovered her powers, the game has a simple gameplay to dodge, jump obstacles, collect potions and defeat monsters, the game is made with beautiful graphics in pixel style 3D with cartoon.


[b][i]PuzzlePet - Feed your cat[/i][/b]

Kittens love to play and walk everywhere until they get tired, then it's time to sleep or eat. In this game, solve puzzles by managing food and feeding the kittens scattered across the stage.


[b]Functionalities:[/b]
[list][*]Click to move, collect and feed the kittens.[/list]
[list][*]Minimalist graphics;[/list]
[list][*]50 levels;[/list]
[list][*]Relaxing music[/list]

Feed a cute kitten today!
